name: Saumur

rules.yield_base: 60 hl/ha for white, 57 for red and rosé, 67 for sparkling white and rosé

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
There is no legal or agreed definition of old, so the words promise nothing on their own.

notes: Saumur's Cabernet Franc reds are light and fruity.

blurb.text: A Loire Valley appellation noted for traditional-method sparkling wine and for reds made mainly from Cabernet Franc. Whites are mainly Chenin Blanc.
